basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT BHU Recruitment 2026 has one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT (BHU) Varanasi. The post is in an ANRF-IRG project, and ANRF is the funding agency. The duration is 2.3 years, and the post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for the third year. You need post-graduation in Mathematics with 55% or above marks (equivalent grade) and NET/GATE or equivalent. Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator within 21 days of the advert

age_limit.details: The notice gives the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post as 28 years. qualification.details: Post Minimum Essential Qualifications Junior Research Fellow Post-graduation in Mathematics with 55% or above marks (equivalent grade) and NET/GATE or equivalent as per specifications of the funding agency (ANRF). | NET/GATE is part of the minimum essential qualification. The application form asks whether you have qualified in UGC/CSIR/NET/GATE (or equivalent) and asks for the details if you have. You can also list research or work experience on the form, but experience is not part of the minimum qualification.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form attached to the notice ("Application for Junior Research Fellow"). Your application must strictly follow this format.
Paste a photograph in the space on the form. Sign the declaration and write the place and date.
Make PDF files of self-attested copies of all your mark sheets and certificates.
Email the application and the PDFs to the Principal Investigator, Prof. Rajeev, at [email protected].
Write "Application for JRF-ANRF-IRG 2026" in the subject line of the email.
Send it within 21 days of the advertisement. The notice does not print the date of the advertisement.
Your name in block letters, and your father's or husband's name
Category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/Gen), and whether you are differently abled (Yes/No)
Date of birth and address for communication
Contact numbers (mobile and residence) and email ID (mandatory)
Educational qualifications from SSC/Matric onwards: examination passed, subject(s), university or board, year of passing, division or class, and % of marks. Attested copies must be enclosed.
Research or work experience, if any: organisation with designation, period of service (from and to), salary and reasons for leaving. Attested copies of supporting documents must be enclosed.
Whether you have qualified in UGC/CSIR/NET/GATE (or an equivalent examination), with details
A photograph and a signed declaration that the information is correct and nothing is suppressed
The application form in the attached format
Self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates, in PDF format
Attested copies of supporting documents for any research or work experience
important_instructions: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. No other communication about this will be entertained. If you are selected, you are expected to join immediately. For questions, contact Prof. Rajeev (Principal Investigator), Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT(BHU), Varanasi-221005, Email: [email protected]. The notice also refers candidates to the website www.iitbhu.ac.in/positions_available.

content_sections.heading: About IIT BHU
content_sections.text: IIT (BHU) Varanasi is an Indian Institute of Technology in Varanasi (PIN 221005). This post is in its Department of Mathematical Sciences. It serves a research project sanctioned for 36 months under the ANRF-IRG scheme. The Principal Investigator is Prof. Rajeev.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: NET/GATE is part of the minimum essential qualification. The application form asks whether you have qualified in UGC/CSIR/NET/GATE (or equivalent) and asks for the details if you have. You can also list research or work experience on the form, but experience is not part of the minimum qualification. The notice gives the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post as 28 years. Age relaxation will be as per GoI norms. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? rows.minimum_essential_qualifications: Post-graduation in Mathematics with 55% or above marks (equivalent grade) and NET/GATE or equivalent as per specifications of the funding agency (ANRF).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of the monthly emoluments in both periods. The project is sanctioned for a total duration of 36 months. The duration of the post is 2.3 years. The first appointment is for one year and can be continued for the next year depending on performance. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Your name in block letters, and your father's or husband's name Marital status (Married/Single) and nationality Category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/Gen), and whether you are differently abled (Yes/No) Date of birth and address for communication Contact numbers (mobile and residence) and email ID (mandatory) Educational qualifications from SSC/Matric onwards: examination passed, subject(s), university or board, year of passing, division or class, and % of marks. Attested copies must be enclosed. Research or work experience, if any: organisation with designation, period of service (from and to), salary and reasons for leaving. Attested copies of supporting documents must be enclosed. Whether you have qualified in UGC/CSIR/NET/GATE (or an equivalent examination), with details Any other information A photograph and a signed declaration that the information is correct and nothing is suppressed The application form in the attached format Self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates, in PDF format Attested copies of supporting documents for any research or work experience

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview is held at the Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT (BHU), Varanasi- 221005. Shortlisted candidates must bring: The application form All documents in original A valid ID proof recognised by the Government of India One set of self-attested copies of proof of date of birth, mark sheets, certificates, NET Certificate, GATE Certificate, experience certificate(s) and other documents No TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for the interview. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. No other communication about this will be entertained. If you are selected, you are expected to join immediately. For questions, contact Prof. Rajeev (Principal Investigator), Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT(BHU), Varanasi-221005, Email: [email protected] . The notice also refers candidates to the website www.iitbhu.ac.in/positions_available.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT BHU JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow post. It is in the Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT (BHU) Varanasi, under an ANRF-IRG project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 21 days of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: You need post-graduation in Mathematics with 55% or above marks (equivalent grade) and NET/GATE or equivalent as per the specifications of the funding agency (ANRF).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years. Age relaxation will be as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT BHU JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 per month (first two years) and the Rs. 42,000 per month (third year).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form and self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates (in PDF format) to Prof. Rajeev at [email protected]. The form must follow the attached format.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for JRF-ANRF-IRG 2026" in the subject line of the email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: Selection is by shortlisting and an interview at the Department of Mathematical Sciences, IIT (BHU), Varanasi- 221005. Shortlisted candidates are told by email, and the Selection Committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIT BHU JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Its duration is 2.3 years: the first appointment is for one year and can be continued depending on performance.
